task.description:
Validate the design artefacts for IN-UI-05 through IN-UI-08. All four are classified as Type E (novel/cross-cutting frontend components). Run per-artefact checks:
1. python tools/lint_design_artefact.py <artefact> for each design file
2. Verify every acceptance criterion in every MUST requirement has a design element
3. Verify no implementation code is present (Type E)
4. Verify all public function/component signatures are listed
5. Verify error taxonomy exists for each design
6. Verify dependencies documented
7. Verify classification per templates/lego-catalog.md is correct
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement acceptance criterion has a design element
No implementation code in design files

result.summary: All four design artefacts validated successfully. Every MUST requirement (IN-UI-05, IN-UI-06, IN-UI-07) has complete acceptance-criterion coverage. IN-UI-08 (SHOULD priority) also fully covered. All lint checks exit 0. Type E classification is correct for all four: each is a sub-component or cross-cutting behaviour within existing pages, not a standalone list page (Type B), CRUD endpoint (Type A), migration (Type C), or React Flow node (Type D). No implementation code present — all files contain design signatures only. All public component/function signatures listed with full interfaces. Error taxonomy tables present in all four files. Dependencies documented in all four files.
